title: Software Development In Test Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Role Overview

As a Software Development in Test (SDET) Intern, you’ll have the opportunity to be a key player in setting a high quality bar for our users. You’ll work on designing and implementing automated testing processes while getting exposure to a key function at Together AI. 

Across teams like Cluster Management and Inference Platform, our work centers on automating and testing the critical flows behind our infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to gain deep insight into how AI infrastructure is provisioned, managed, and scaled or to get hands-on experience benchmarking the newest cutting edge open source models.

This role is on-site at our HQ in San Francisco, CA.

Responsibilities

• Developing automated test scripts for functionality, performance, and reliability testing across the website and services

• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code with a focus on long-term maintainability

• Extend and improve test automation frameworks to increase efficiency and overall coverage across the platform.

• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand project requirements and contribute to defining test plans and quality standards

Minimum Qualifications

• Actively pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, earned or expected by Summer 2028

• Excellent programming skills in Typescript, Go or Python

• Knowledge of automation testing methodologies, tools, and best practices

• Ability to solve problems creatively and communicate trade-offs effectively

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior SDET experience through internships, hackathons, or projects

• Experience in API Testing, AI infrastructure, and/or Git workflows and CI automation.

• Experience with Playwright or Cypress

About Together AI

Together AI is a research-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co-designing software, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancements such as FlashAttention, Mamba, FlexGen, Petals, Mixture of Agents, and RedPajama.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span either May 17th to August 6th or June 14th to September 3rd. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 an hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy

description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Black Lotus Labs has an opening for a Senior Lead Threat Analyst that will leverage Lumen’s unique visibility to hunt, investigate, and scale discovery of evolving malicious threats, provide mission-relevant intelligence, and support mitigations on large networks. Our global visibility into one of the world’s largest and most interconnected IP backbones, combined with our computing cluster and analytic platforms, presents exciting opportunities to integrate machine learning, graph analytics, automation, and approved AI-enabled tools as we find new ways to hunt for threats across the internet. Black Lotus Labs has detected and disrupted key evolving threats at an internet scale for years.

This position will work alongside Black Lotus Labs advanced security researchers, data engineers, malware reverse engineers, data scientists, and our customers to tackle evolving threats accelerated by technologies like our Hadoop ecosystem (HBase, HDFS, Spark, Kafka, AirFlow), Elasticsearch and Redis clusters, Docker using Docker Swarm, malware environment, a network of honeypots, and modern AI-assisted research and development capabilities.
This is a close-knit, experienced, amazingly smart team that you can be a part of and help build out.

This position requires an active TS/SCI security clearance w/ CI Poly.

Location

This is a remote position with office visits in Herndon, VA approximately 2 times per month.

• Research latest threat attacker tools, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) with a goal of automating detection.

• Automate investigations through Python scripting and data analysis using visualization in Jupyter Notebooks and Grafana

• Build and maintain trust relationships with other intelligence teams, law enforcement, and other outside groups.

• Support customer RFIs on incidents and emerging threats.

• Use approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate research, coding, data exploration, documentation, and knowledge discovery while validating outputs through independent analytical judgment.

• Develop repeatable workflows that combine analyst expertise, automation, and AI-assisted capabilities to improve investigative efficiency and analytical quality.

What We Look For in a Candidate

• Familiarity with adversary capabilities, infrastructure, and techniques that can be applied in collaboration with supporting teams and partners to discover, track, and defend against the adversaries aggression towards customer networks.

• Experience using OSINT methods for investigation, including discovering novel threats in malware repositories.

• Scripting experience with Python and familiarity with distributed computing.

• Extensive experience hunting threat actors and developing algorithms and techniques to identify new threats from large data sets.

• Deep knowledge of network-based threats and identifying behaviors without attack payloads.

description:
About Renaissance

When you join Renaissance ®, you join a global leader in pre-K-12 education technology! Renaissance ’s solutions help educators analyze, customize, and plan personalized learning paths for students, allowing time for what matters-creating energizing learning experiences in the classroom. Our fiercely passionate employees and educational partners have helped drive phenomenal student growth, with Renaissance solutions being used in over one-third of US schools and in more than 100 countries worldwide.

Every day, we are connected to our mission by exemplifying our values: trust each other, win together, strive for the best, own our actions, and grow and evolve.

UX Researcher II Job Description

Under general supervision, conduct research efforts and develop clear stories from insights that support partner and team alignment on user-focused goals. This includes collaborating with UX designers, product owners, product managers, and engineers to discover opportunities for future products and validate designs for product optimization.

In this role as a UX Researcher II, you will be responsible for:

• Design, plan, and execute end-to-end research studies using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methodologies with guidance from senior team members

• Conduct and synthesize research projects including user interviews, usability testing sessions, surveys, card sorting, and contribute to A/B testing initiatives

• Synthesize research findings into clear, actionable insights and present recommendations to cross-functional teams with a compelling, influential story.

• Analyze insights from research sessions to identify key opportunities and user needs

• Works collaboratively and communicates effectively with peers and managers

• Monitor and analyze user behavior metrics and usability benchmarks with support from senior researchers

• Support the evaluation and optimization of research methodologies to improve quality and efficiency of insights

• Assist with research operations including participant recruitment, scheduling, and research repository maintenance

Qualifications

For this role as a UX Researcher II, you should have:

• Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, Social Science, Design Research, Psychology, Cognitive Science or related field

• 3-5 years of experience in UX Research or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Proficiency in qualitative research methods including interviews, contextual inquiry and observational studies

• Working knowledge of quantitative research methods including survey design and basic statistical analysis

• Familiarity with mixed-methods research approaches

• Experience with evaluative research including usability testing and heuristic evaluation

• Exposure to generative and exploratory research techniques

• Ability to execute research protocols and discussion guides

• Experience with participant recruitment and screening

• Understanding of research ethics and informed consent practices

• Experience conducting research with diverse user groups

Bonus Points:

• Portfolio showcasing research projects, methodologies applied, and measurable impact on product outcomes

title: Senior BI Analyst, Reporting & BI (m/f/x)
description:
The Role

As a Senior BI Analyst in the Reporting & BI team, you will be the owner of HelloFresh's data landscape for your domain. You will build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers executive decision-making - from creating data pipelines and ETL jobs to building executive-level dashboards and conducting deep-dive analyses.

You combine analytical depth with engineering capabilities: translating ambiguous business questions into actionable insights and own end-to-end delivery - from raw data ingestion through transformation pipelines to polished dashboards and strategic recommendations that reach C-suite stakeholders.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at building things: pipelines, data models, dashboards, and insights - all while ensuring data quality, scalability, and business impact.

What You'll Do: The Recipe

• Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using dbt, Databricks, Spark SQL, and Airflow - transforming raw data into robust, scalable models that power analytics across the business

• Act as the steward of your domain's data landscape: implement automated data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to proactively catch issues, and troubleshoot pipeline failures with timely root-cause fixes

• Write performant, maintainable SQL for large-scale data transformations and collaborate with central Data Engineering teams on schema design and technical requirements

• Build and maintain executive-level BI dashboards (Tableau, Databricks) and conduct deep-dive analyses that translate complex, ambiguous business questions into data-driven strategic recommendations

• Own critical business reporting (WBRs, QBRs, forecasting) and act as the trusted analytics partner across Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations - ensuring insights are accurate, timely, and actionable

• Document data models, pipelines, and methodologies to enable self-service, and mentor junior analysts and engineers on SQL best practices, data modeling, and stakeholder communication

What You'll Bring: The Ingredients

• 6+ years of experience in BI Analytics, Data Engineering, or Analytics Engineering - ideally in a fast-paced B2C, subscription, or growth-oriented business

• Advanced SQL proficiency and data pipeline experience - comfortable with complex transformations, performance-tuning, and building/troubleshooting ETL/ELT pipelines at scale

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

The SandboxAQ Design team is one unified organization spanning brand, creative, and product, with designers embedded day-to-day in the Business Units they support. This role will initially be working on our AI agentic platform and products.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our central Design team, reporting to the VP of Design. You will define how people build, evaluate, and trust AI agents in an emerging category, making complex technical concepts understandable across both open-source developer products and enterprise control systems. What makes this work genuinely hard: the category is entirely new yet fast-evolving and crowded, and the audiences are deeply varied.

In this role, you will:

- Turn unique value propositions into well-crafted, intuitive UX.

- Design for deeply varied audiences, from command-line-first developers to enterprise security leaders, constantly balancing power, privacy, control, and speed.

- Create coherent experiences across the product's surfaces: command line, web and console, collaboration spaces, onboarding, and documentation.

- Establish the reusable patterns, design principles, and systems thinking the product family grows into.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Drive product vision and direction. Partner with Product and Engineering to define what should be built and how it should work, frame ambiguous problems into clear opportunities, hypotheses, and design directions, break long and complex projects into executable units of work, and identify risks and opportunities to solve collectively.

- Design and prototype in code to accelerate product decisions, customer conversations, and team alignment, collaborating with engineers early so technical constraints shape the design.

- Own visual and interaction design across every surface - command line, web and console, collaboration spaces, onboarding, and documentation - developing and evolving a style guide and design system, and contributing reusable patterns and design principles as the product family grows.

- Ground decisions in evidence. Conduct workshops, qualitative interviews, usability testing, and other research methods, analyze product analytics to improve user interactions, and distil complex, dense information into clarifying data visualizations and views for the various lenses of user archetypes.

- Operate as part of the org-wide design function. Maintain dotted-line, cross-departmental collaboration with design functions in other SandboxAQ Business Units, interface with go-to-market partners on interfaces that support Sandbox's strategic partnership efforts, and travel occasionally to work with teams and customers in person.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- ~6+ years building interfaces for complex technical domains - developer tools, enterprise, security, infrastructure, or AI - with exceptional visual and interaction design craft.

- Strong working knowledge of AI and agentic products and systems,

title: Parcel Point Agent
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position

Vinted Go has opened its very own parcel centres in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Paris and Bordeaux, and the network is expanding. At the centre, Vinted parcels can be collected and dropped-off by customers.
As a parcel centre agent in our new parcel point in Amsterdam, you help customers with their parcels, receive and return parcel bags to drivers, and proactively communicate with colleagues to further improve the centre. 

In this position, you’ll

• Assist customers with dropping off and picking up their parcels.

• Facilitate drivers in the drop-off and pick-up of bags.

• Provide guidance and support to customers experiencing issues with their shipments.

• Maintain a tidy and organized work environment.

• Communicate effectively with other team members to ensure smooth operation.

• Communicate with the representatives of other carriers shipped at the point.

• 7 months fixed term contract.

• 40h per week. 

About you

• Proficiency in English. Dutch is an advantage.

• Excellent customer service skills.

• Ability to represent a brand in a professional and friendly manner.

• Prior experience in a similar role is advantageous.

• Good organisational abilities and attention to detail.

• Open to work on a 6 month fixed-term contract.

• Open to work full-time: 40h per week (including some Saturdays)

Work perks

• 25 days of paid annual leave

• Pension plan with a total contribution of 12%, 8% by the Company and 4% by employee

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

• Company bike leasing scheme

• Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

• Lunch benefit per working day

• Frequent team-building events

• Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

• NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

Working at Vinted

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway - you might still be the perfect match!

The gross salary for this position is: €32,000 per year.

title: Healthcare Receptionist
description:
Position: Healthcare Receptionist
Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)
Full-Time, Remote Work.
Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)
We are looking for a highly organized, compassionate, and detail-oriented Healthcare Receptionist.
The Healthcare Receptionist will be responsible for managing the intake process from the initial point of contact through to the completion of required documentation and coordination of services. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and family information professionally.
The ideal candidate will have experience in healthcare administration.
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients, families, and referral sources.

• Respond to phone calls, emails, and inquiries regarding ABA therapy services.

• Collect and verify patient and family information during the intake process.

• Gather required documentation, including insurance information, referrals, medical records, and other supporting documents.

• Verify insurance eligibility and benefits where required.

• Coordinate with insurance providers, healthcare professionals, referral sources, and internal teams.

• Review referrals and ensure all required information is received before moving cases forward.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records within the organization's systems.

• Schedule assessments, consultations, and other appointments as required.

• Follow up with families and referral sources regarding outstanding documentation or next steps.

• Communicate the intake status clearly to internal teams.

• Identify missing or incorrect information and take appropriate action to resolve issues.

• Ensure all intake activities are completed accurately and within required timelines.

• Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy and data protection requirements.

• Provide a professional, empathetic, and positive experience for families throughout the intake process.

• Assist with administrative tasks related to admissions, referrals, authorizations, and onboarding.

Requirements

• Previous experience in healthcare administration

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information professionally.

• Comfortable communicating with parents, caregivers, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.

• Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office setup.

• Ability to work US business hours.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist)
Full-Time | Remote | Dubai-Based Property Group
About Our Client
OutsourcedIn is looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist) to join a growing Dubai-based property group operating as part of a larger international investment organisation.
Our client is building a sophisticated digital acquisition capability to support the continued growth of its property business, with a strong focus on generating qualifi ed buyer and investor enquiries through paid digital channels.
This is an opportunity for an experienced performance marketer to take meaningful ownership of the complete paid acquisition journey from the fi rst impression through to the lead entering the CRM.
The successful candidate will be joining the client's team on a full-time, long-term basis and will work remotely while supporting a Dubai-based business.
The Role
As the Digital Marketing Specialist (Paid Ads Specialist), you will be responsible for building, managing and continuously improving the client's digital lead-generation engine.
Meta Ads and Google Ads will sit at the centre of the role.
However, we are not looking for someone who simply launches campaigns and reports on cost per click.
You will take ownership of the entire paid acquisition loop:
Ad Audience Landing Page Lead Capture Tracking CRM Automation Reporting Optimisation
You will be expected to understand how each component aff ects the next.
When a campaign generates traffi c but not enquiries, you need to determine why.
When cost per lead increases, you need to identify what changed and take action.
When Meta reports leads that cannot be reconciled with the CRM, you need to investigate the tracking.
When lead volume increases but lead quality deteriorates, you need to determine whether the problem sits with the audience, off er, creative, messaging, funnel or qualifi cation process.
This is a highly hands-on position for someone who understands both the marketing and technical infrastructure behind successful performance campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Paid Advertising & Lead Generation
Your primary responsibility will be generating a consistent pipeline of qualifi ed property enquiries through paid digital channels.
You will:
Plan, build, launch and optimise campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
Develop paid media strategies aligned with specifi c properties, developments, audiences and commercial objectives.
Manage campaign structures, budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation and geographic targeting.
Develop and test audiences across prospecting, retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
Write and refi ne performance-focused advertising copy.
Work with creative resources to develop advertising assets designed around campaign objectives.
Develop clear creative briefs based on performance data and testing requirements.
Run structured A/B tests across creatives, hooks, messaging, audiences, off ers and calls to action.

• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of two (growth and lifecycle) from day one, owning the opportunity to hire and expand the team as the business grows.

• Cross-Functional Storytelling: Translate performance into clear narratives for leadership, and keep founders, product, and marketing aligned on where shopper is headed and why.

Calendly is the incumbent, and it's good. Our thesis: booking links make it efficient to fill your calendar, not productive. Every open slot looks identical, so your best hours go to whoever clicks first. Arrangr schedules by importance. The opportunity: we can see which companies already have several people using Arrangr individually. Each of those is an unmonetized team. You'd build the motion that converts them (in-product surface, sequences, landing page, pilot) and handle the replies it generates: seats, admin rights, security questions. Then reactivate a large dormant base and fix acquisition. The engagement: five milestones over roughly three months, $12K paid on milestone completion, milestones 1 and 2 contracted first. "Done" means shipped, instrumented and measured against a baseline. Equity is a defined grant tied to new ARR booked; hitting the middle tier triggers a founding title. Engineering time is limited, so you ship within existing product surfaces. Right for you if you've run PQL-to-team expansion and reactivation against a base in the tens of thousands. Not for CRO specialists (our volume won't support the testing), paid media buyers, or anyone who wants to manage a team. There is no team. You're it. To apply: no cover letter. Email adams@arrangr.com with three links to things you personally built, one line each on what the numbers did. Plus one answer: we can see which companies have several individual users. How would you turn that into team conversions, and have you run that motion before? I read and reply to every one. - Adam, co-founder/CEO

title: Chief Strategy Officer
description:
Position Overview:
The Chief Strategy Officer is responsible for defining, developing, and executing the organization's long-term strategic vision. The CSO works closely with executive leadership to identify growth opportunities, drive strategic initiatives, and ensure alignment across business units. This role requires strong analytical thinking, business acumen, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans that deliver measurable results.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Corporate Strategy Development

• Lead the development of short-term and long-term strategic plans aligned with organizational goals.

• Identify growth opportunities, new markets, and competitive positioning strategies.

• Conduct strategic reviews and adjust plans based on market dynamics.

2. Business Planning & Execution

• Translate strategic objectives into actionable business plans and initiatives.

• Partner with business units to ensure effective execution of strategic priorities.

• Monitor progress and ensure alignment with overall corporate strategy.

3. Market & Competitive Analysis

• Conduct in-depth analysis of industry trends, competitors, and market opportunities.

• Provide insights on emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Support decision-making through data-driven analysis and research.

4. Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

• Lead or support mergers, acquisitions, and strategic partnerships.

• Conduct due diligence, financial analysis, and integration planning.

• Identify and evaluate potential investment or expansion opportunities.

5. Performance Management & Reporting

• Establish KPIs and performance metrics to track strategic initiatives.

• Monitor organizational performance and recommend improvements.

• Provide regular strategic updates to the CEO and Board.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with leadership across operations, finance, marketing, IT, and other functions.

• Ensure alignment and coordination across departments for strategy execution.

• Drive organization-wide initiatives and transformation programs.

7. Innovation & Transformation

• Lead innovation initiatives and digital transformation strategies.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

8. Stakeholder Engagement

• Present strategic plans and insights to executive leadership and the Board.

• Engage with external stakeholders, partners, and industry experts.

• Represent the organization in strategic discussions and forums.

9. Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and mentor strategy, planning, and analytics teams.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on strategic thinking and execution.

• Ensure continuous development of talent and capabilities.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

• 12-15+ years of experience in strategy, consulting, corporate planning, or senior leadership roles.

• Proven track record in developing and executing successful business strategies.

• Strong understanding of market dynamics, financial analysis, and business operations.

Key Skills and Competencies:

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.

• Leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Ability to drive change and organizational transformation.

Performance Metrics:

• Achievement of strategic goals and business growth targets.

• Success of strategic initiatives and transformation programs.

• Market expansion and competitive positioning.

• Efficiency and effectiveness of business operations.

• Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description: We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile. When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models. The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role. The work Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently. You'll work on two related areas. Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people. AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. We're looking for a Major Account Executive to own and grow a book of strategic enterprise accounts. Responsibilities

• Own and grow a book of major/strategic accounts, running the full cycle from qualification through multi-year contract negotiation and close

• Partner with technical presales Solutions Architects to run live technical evaluations and proof-of-concepts that hold up under real scrutiny from technical buyers

• Structure and negotiate enterprise contracts, with a strong bias toward multi-year (3-year) terms

• Build and defend a business case that speaks fluently to both risk reduction (CISO language) and ROI (CFO language) - you need both, not one

• Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene on long-cycle (6-9 month), high-ACV deals

• Prioritize Customer Success for account health, since renewal risk on an account this size is a shared problem, not a handoff

Skills and Qualifications

• 8+ years of closing experience in enterprise cybersecurity/SaaS

• Demonstrated ability to close deals upwards of $1M ARR or more and 6+ month sales cycles

• Track record of navigating security-specific procurement: vendor risk assessments, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 diligence, security questionnaires, and legal review cycles that are more adversarial than typical SaaS procurement

• Comfort being technically challenged in a room - you don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own when a CISO pressure-tests your claims

• Experience structuring and closing multi-year contracts, not just annual renewals

• A hunter mentality - use relationships & partnerships to find leverage to close deals

• and this role rewards depth and judgment over sheer volume

Perks

• 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

• Flexible PTO policy

• Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

• Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. title: Senior Manager, Revenue Partnerships
description:
About AiPrise Inc.

AiPrise is a YC-backed, Series A company building the global compliance infrastructure for financial services. We help banks, fintechs, cross-border payment providers, stablecoin and crypto companies, and marketplaces gain a 360° view of every business they onboard, anywhere in the world.

Through a single integration, we connect 800+ data sources and 80+ verification partners across 200+ countries, powering KYB, KYC, AML, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring for companies like Meta, Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Bridge.

Our AI Agents help compliance teams do more with less, resolving more cases, catching more fraud, and scaling operations without scaling headcount.

We're ~60 people, Series A funded, and obsessed with a single problem: making compliance feel simple for the teams who live in it every day.

Borders shouldn't be blockers. Compliance is hard. AiPrise shouldn't be.

The role

You'll own revenue generating partnerships end to end: finding and signing new partners, running and growing the partners we already have, and shaping how the partnerships strategy evolves as the company scales.

This is a senior individual-contributor role on a small, ambitious team. You'll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, sit very close to Sales, Finance and Product, and have a lot of autonomy to build. You will spend real time in the field because the relationships that move revenue are built in person.

What you'll do

Source and sign new revenue partners

• Build and work a pipeline of prospective partners across referral, reseller, technology/ISV, BPO, and platform categories.

• Qualify partners against fit, overlap, and revenue potential; prioritize ruthlessly.

• Run the full partner sales cycle: outreach, discovery, business case, commercial structure, and agreement.

• Represent AiPrise at conferences and industry events; turn event conversations into signed partnerships.

Run and grow existing partners

• Own the relationship, cadence, and revenue plan for a portfolio of active partners.

• Build joint go-to-market plans with each priority partner: target accounts, plays, enablement, marketing, and a shared pipeline.

• Drive co-selling with our AEs: account mapping, warm intros, joint calls, and deal coordination.

• Enable partner teams to position and sell AiPrise properly; keep them informed and motivated as our product evolves.

• Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue; run regular partner reviews.

• Grow into ownership of a partner revenue target as the motion matures.

Shape the strategy

• Bring a point of view on which partner categories and specific partners we should pursue, and why.

• Feed market, competitive, and customer intelligence from the partner ecosystem back into Sales, Product, and Leadership.

• Help design and refine partner program mechanics: tiers, incentives, referral and reseller economics, enablement.

• Contribute to the partnerships operating model through reporting, tooling (HubSpot, Crossbeam), and process as the team and company grows.

What success looks like

•
First 90 days: Ramped on market, product, ICP, and current partner portfolio; owning day-to-day relationships with existing revenue partners; a qualified pipeline of new partner opportunities; first 1-2 conference or on-site trips completed.

•
First 6 months: New revenue partners signed; joint GTM plans in place with priority partners; partner-sourced pipeline visible and growing.

•
First 12 months: A repeatable partner motion producing a 20+% of total revenue opportunities with clear attribution and a documented playbook.

What we're looking for

• Builder mindset. You've operated in an early-stage or high-growth environment and know how to create structure without waiting for it.

• 5-8 years in partnerships, alliances, channel, or business development at a B2B SaaS or fintech company

title: Project Manager, Evidence Synthesis

Are you passionate about keeping complex, evidence‑driven projects running smoothly and delivered to the highest standard? Our Evidence Synthesis & Decision Modelling team at Precision AQ is hiring a Project / Portfolio Manager to support global HEOR programs, with a particular focus on Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA) submissions , systematic literature reviews, statistical analyses, and economic models.
This is a highly visible, client‑facing role, partnering with senior scientific leaders to ensure projects are well‑planned, well‑run, and delivered on time and to expectation.
About you:
You are an experienced project manager with a strong understanding of HEOR‑related deliverables and consulting environments. You thrive in coordinating complex, multi‑workstream projects and enjoy working closely with both internal teams and external clients. You have experience managing timelines and workloads across multiple concurrent projects, translating high‑level objectives into clear, actionable plans, and proactively identifying and resolving risks to delivery. You are confident interacting with clients, supporting project governance, leading project management discussions, and acting as a trusted point of contact for organization, planning, and progress tracking.You are detail‑oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with scientific and technical teams delivering literature reviews, quantitative analyses, and economic models.

As a Project / Portfolio Manager within the Evidence Synthesis & Decision Modelling team, you will work closely with scientific project leads (e.g., Directors, VPs) and cross‑functional contributors across evidence synthesis, statistics, and health economic modelling.
You will be responsible for end‑to‑end project management , including planning, resourcing, timeline development, progress tracking, risk management, and delivery oversight across individual projects and portfolios of work (particularly JCA program's).
On client‑facing projects, you will support or lead project management discussions, prepare and maintain project plans, timelines, and reports, and ensure clear communication of status, risks, dependencies, and actions. This will involve monitoring scope changes and managing change order processes, clearly documenting impacts on timelines, resources, and budgets.
You will ensure projects run smoothly by coordinating internal workflows, facilitating alignment across disciplines, documenting decisions and actions, and supporting monitoring and evaluation of agreed processes and milestones. This will involve coordination of both internal/external review cycle timelines and collating feedback from various external reviewers.
You will play a key role in ensuring on‑time delivery, supporting financial and scope tracking, and escalating risks or resourcing issues early to project leadership. You will work with clients to maintain an organized repository of deliverables.
You will support strategic portfolio oversight and prioritization, working with senior leadership to balance competing demands, optimize resource allocation, and align project execution with broader organizational and client objectives.
You will develop and maintain standardized project management tools and templates, ensuring best practices are applied consistently across projects and teams. This will also involve facilitating cross-project knowledge sharing and lessons learned, helping to improve delivery quality and inform future study design and execution.
Where possible, you will leverage project management tools and data to generate insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and transparent reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.
Where required, you will also support proposal development and study start‑up activities, including timeline development.

title: Project Manager, Total Rewards
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners

• Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself

• Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A - becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status

• Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types

• Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better 

• Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers

• Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation - including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land

• Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Safety
description:
Your Impact at LILA

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

At Lila's AI Safety team, you will build the shared software that helps our team understand and reduce societal risks from scientific AI. Working with researchers, domain scientists and program colleagues, you will turn needs across threat modeling, evaluations, red teaming and mitigation development into reliable tools and systems. You will own engineering work from scoping and prototyping through deployment and ongoing improvement, supporting research across scientific models, agents and automated experimentation.

What You'll Be Building

• Build reusable services, libraries and model/tool integrations that make evaluations, red-teaming campaigns and mitigation experiments repeatable.

• Develop applications that help researchers and scientific experts organize evidence, inspect results, review data and investigate failures.

• Work with safety colleagues to understand research needs and identify shared engineering needs, prioritize useful improvements and turn evolving research workflows into maintainable software.
